title: IoU rewards, mDPO, and GRPO for visual grounding
brief: Build the IoU verifier, the RLHF-V and mDPO preference terms that make a model look at the image, and the length penalty that stops box spam, then train a toy grounding policy with GRPO.
hints: In iou, clip every width and height at zero before you multiply. A box whose x2 is below its x1 has zero area, not a negative one. When the union is zero, return 0 rather than dividing.
dense_logprob is a weighted mean: weights are gamma on corrected tokens and 1 elsewhere, and you divide by the sum of the weights, not by the number of tokens.

mdpo_loss uses -log sigmoid(z) = log(1 + exp(-z)). np.logaddexp(0, -z) computes it without overflow. The conditional term compares the chosen response on the real image with the same response on the corrupted image.
detection_reward: compute a (predictions, targets) IoU matrix with broadcasting, take the max over predictions for each target, average over targets, then multiply by min(1, targets / predictions).
In train_grounding, sample the boxes under torch.no_grad(), then compute gaussian_logprob of those fixed boxes with gradients on. The loss is -(advantages * logp).mean().
